related.title: 白鶴灘水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」與「智慧灌漿與數位化施工」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations" and "Intelligent grouting and digital construction" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦薄型特高拱壩、850 MW 機組與岸邊洩洪洞的整體設計；白鶴灘水電站則以百萬瓩級機組、289 m 雙曲拱壩與低熱水泥全壩應用為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrated design of a thin ultra-high arch dam, 850 MW units and bank spillway tunnels; Baihetan Hydropower Station centres on million-kilowatt units, a 289 m double-curvature arch dam and low-heat cement throughout, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到白鶴灘水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Baihetan Hydropower Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」與「智慧灌漿與數位化施工」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations" and "Intelligent grouting and digital construction" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.

related.title: 溪洛渡水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」與「智慧灌漿與數位化施工」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；溪洛渡水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations" and "Intelligent grouting and digital construction" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Xiluodu Hydropower Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦薄型特高拱壩、850 MW 機組與岸邊洩洪洞的整體設計；溪洛渡水電站則以285.5 m 拱壩的壩身孔口洩洪、地下廠房與金沙江梯級聯合調度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrated design of a thin ultra-high arch dam, 850 MW units and bank spillway tunnels; Xiluodu Hydropower Station centres on orifice flood discharge through a 285.5 m arch dam, underground powerhouses and joint operation of the Jinsha cascade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到溪洛渡水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「壩身孔口水舌碰撞消能」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Xiluodu Hydropower Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Jet collision from dam-body outlets", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」與「智慧灌漿與數位化施工」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；溪洛渡水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations" and "Intelligent grouting and digital construction" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Xiluodu Hydropower Station must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 烏東德水電站
history.text: 2015 年主體工程核准開工；2017 年大壩開始澆築；2020 年水庫蓄水，首批機組於 6 月投產；2021 年12 台機組於 6 月全部投產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2015: Main works were approved and started. 2017: Dam concreting began. 2020: The reservoir was impounded and the first units entered service in June. 2021: All twelve units were in service by June. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
